**Platform capabilities** (all available at runtime; advertise the ones you use in `manifest.json` → `capabilities`): `fs`, `exec`, `cron`, `jobs`, `ai`, `cli`, `db`, `state`, `settings`, `secrets`, `files`, `http`, `notify`, `dialogs`, `tasks`, `events`, `ui`, `tools`, `artifacts`, `identity`, `capabilities`, `audio`, `music`, `maps`, `web-search`, `embeddings`, `memory`, `google`, `email`, `calendar`, `todos`, `browser`, `telegram`, `whatsapp`, `apps`, `licensing`, `platform-cron`, `sysmon`, `print`, `governance`, `spend`, `fleet`, `config`.
One line each, with where to read more, in the Section Index below.

Media AI (audio in/out, image generation, translation), Maps and Web Search all use
platform-managed keys — never ask the user for an API key for them.
